metadata.name: design-guidance-arms-geometry-pilot
metadata.intent: Design-guidance pilot, arms geometry profile: how pilot-grade Type I and power of the delta / angle / shape RRPP tests for the geometry mode(s) depend on group ratio, stage proportions, differential-feature proportion, joint stage effect and baseline continuity, one at a time off the core baseline, under the production measurement (pooled PLS with the stage-supervised double-CV rank, net-displacement orientation, rank floor 2, joint magnitude). Phase 5 sensitivity deliverable (sample size, stages, blocks, signal density); 100 replicates x 199 permutations.
notes: Explicit design points (design D4), one setting moved at a time off the core baseline (n = 200, three stages, two blocks): group_ratio {0.65, 0.8}; stage_sample_prop 0.5/0.3/0.2; p_dmp {0.05, 0.15} (0.2 fails the three-stage headroom check: orientation saturates at e = 0.89 and translation at 0.52; 0.15 fits, saturating at 1.39 and 1.12); the joint stage effect delta_methyl = delta_expr = delta_protein in {0.25, 0.5, 1.0} (below InterSIM's 2.0; the rank-floor check saw stage signal vanish near 0.05-0.1 at n = 80); baseline_continuity {0.5, 0.8}. 11 columns, the baseline listed. An SEA-AD-style group x stage table is not repeated: the Phase 6 net-displacement power profile measured it.

Modes orientation, shape and translation at e in {0.25, 0.5, 1.0}: orientation and shape sit near the null below 0.25 at n = 80; e = 0.75 is dropped to save a cell per mode. Translation is the location-only negative control read against the anchor bound.

Cells and cost: 2 Type I baselines + 11 columns x (1 anchor + 3 mode(s) x 3 effects) = 112 cells, 11,200 work units at 100 replicates. The n = 1000 columns dominate the core profiles' compute; shard counts and the core-hour estimate come from the local smoke run recorded in the change notes.

Design-guidance pilot (change design-guidance-grid, 2026-10-28): the replacement for the project's originally planned simulation grid (Table 1). Four profiles share one baseline (n = 200, three stages, group_ratio 0.5, p_dmp 0.1, rho 0, every per-omic delta 2.0, joint magnitude; pooled PLS on methylation + expression with the Phase 6 CV knobs), one seed root (base_seed 1028) and one matched-seed family (design-guidance), at pilot grade: 100 replicates x 199 permutations.

Production measurement named, not defaulted (design-guidance spec, 'profiles name the production measurement'): orientation_estimator net_displacement, min_components 2 and magnitude_kind joint are written out so the profile states what it measures under. This is a post-floor config: it is pinned in tests/data/post_floor_config_identity.json, not in the historical pre-flip fixture, and it does not copy the historical 'pc1' / min_components 1 pins.

Magnitude and geometry are split into sibling profiles (design D1) because one effect list cannot serve both: magnitude's delta rise sits at e = 0.01-0.25 while orientation and shape leave the null only from e = 0.25. The siblings share base_seed and the seed family, so at a given design column their zero-effect anchors have different cell ids but draw the same generator seed and evaluate the same datasets (design D2). The findings report reads the geometry profile's anchor and uses the magnitude profile's anchor as a reproduction check; it never pools the two as independent replicates.

acceptance: a type_i entry and the advisory anchor_decision (alpha 0.05, k = 2, delta/angle/shape; bound 0.0936 at R = 100). No power targets, no gate, no report contract (design D8): the pilot is descriptive, proposes the slice to rerun at paper grade, and makes no floor claims.
surgery_censoring stays at its default ('error'); enumeration rejects any over-headroom cell before compute is spent. Do not pass --n-jobs; parallelize across shards.

submission.n_shards: set from the local smoke timings (openspec change notes) before submission
